import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MODUL = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 33;
    static long[] binary = new long[MAX_SIZE * 2];
    static long n_value, m_value;

    static class MatrixType {
        long[][] matrix = new long[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];

        MatrixType multiply(MatrixType other) {
            MatrixType result = new MatrixType();
            for (int i = 0; i <= m_value; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m_value; j++) {
                    result.matrix[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= m_value; k++) {
                        result.matrix[i][j] = (result.matrix[i][j] + this.matrix[i][k] * other.matrix[k][j]) % MODUL;
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static int get_input(Scanner sc) {
        int x = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        char ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
        while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
            if (ch == '-') sign = -1;
            ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
        }
        while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + (ch - '0');
            if (sc.hasNext()) {
                ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        return x * sign;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n_value = get_input(sc);
        m_value = get_input(sc);
        long temp_n = n_value;
        int length = -1;
        while (temp_n != 0) {
            length++;
            binary[length] = temp_n % m_value;
            temp_n /= m_value;
        }
        length++;
        MatrixType result = new MatrixType();
        for (int i = 0; i <= m_value; i++) {
            result.matrix[0][i] = 1;
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MatrixType[][] P = new MatrixType[MAX_SIZE * 2][];
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MatrixType[][] S = new MatrixType[MAX_SIZE * 2][];
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MatrixType[][] A = new MatrixType[MAX_SIZE * 2][];

        for (int i = 0; i <= m_value; i++) {
            A[0] = new MatrixType[MAX_SIZE];
            for (int j = 0; j <= m_value; j++) {
                A[0][i] = new MatrixType();
                for (int k = 0; k < MAX_SIZE; k++) {
                    A[0][i].matrix[k][k] = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            A[i] = new MatrixType[MAX_SIZE];
            for (int j = 0; j <= m_value; j++) {
                A[i][j] = new MatrixType();
                for (int k = 0; k < MAX_SIZE; k++) {
                    A[i][j].matrix[k][k] = 1;
                }
            }
            if (i == 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m_value; j++) {
                    A[i][j].matrix[m_value][m_value] = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < m_value; k++) {
                        if (k != j) {
                            A[i][j].matrix[k][k] = 1;
                            for (int l = 0; l <= m_value; l++) {
                                A[i][j].matrix[k][l] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < m_value; j++) {
                    if (j == 0) {
                        A[i][j] = S[i - 1][0];
                    } else {
                        A[i][j] = S[i - 1][j].multiply(P[i - 1][j - 1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            P[i][0] = A[i][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < m_value; j++) {
                P[i][j] = P[i][j - 1].multiply(A[i][j]);
            }
            S[i][m_value - 1] = A[i][m_value - 1];
            for (int j = m_value - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                S[i][j] = A[i][j].multiply(S[i][j + 1]);
            }
        }

        int j = 0;
        for (int i = length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            while (binary[i] > 0) {
                result = result.multiply(A[i][j]);
                j++;
                if (j == m_value) j = 0;
                binary[i]--;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(result.matrix[0][(int) m_value]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
